skipGpu.reason: Portable WGSL floating-point semantics do not guarantee preservation of the subnormal values required by this fixture. Backend evidence: Metal flushes denormals to zero in the ALU; this op's f32 multiply/FMA flushes the subnormal operand on GPU even at identity angle. Permanent FTZ limitation.

Interleaved rotation on the quad route: head size 16 over 2 heads with f16 storage, so each invocation rotates four interleaved pairs read as two vec4s and writes them back in the same interleaving.
Partial rotation on the quad route: rotary dim 8 of head size 24 leaves a 16-element tail that the remaining quad lanes copy as two vec4s each, with a batch-strided cache.

Position-id gather with interleaved rotation on the rank-4 quad route: head size 8 is exactly one quad per head, so the rotate lanes cover every element and the tail branch never runs.
